doubts.claim_under_doubt: audit failure after log write leaves entry logged+listed and retry finishes exactly once
doubts.disproof_attempt: ENOSPC/EBUSY/EIO/EMFILE/vanished/OrgSymlinkEscapeError after the log write are not mapped to AuditUnwritableError; the retry crash-branch swallows the same error and removes the entry with no audit record
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: map every post-log audit failure to audit_pending in both branches

doubts.claim_under_doubt: normalizeLine/foldForCompare cannot be bypassed to smuggle invisible/lookalike quote text
doubts.disproof_attempt: fold runs NFKC before strip so u + ZWSP + combining diaeresis stays decomposed after strip; Cyrillic homoglyphs never folded; noncharacters U+FDD0..FDEF/U+FFFE/F not in INVISIBLE
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: strip, NFKC, strip again; add noncharacters; document homoglyph limit

doubts.claim_under_doubt: cross-site guard closes the drive-by browser path

doubts.what_would_resolve_it: refuse any Sec-Fetch-Site other than same-origin/none when present; correct the doc
